text.tspan: Film one swing down the line with your phone. AIcoach fills in the
card a good coach would: what the fault is, where it comes from,
how sure it is, and what to practise next session.

svg.text: MEASUREMENT: HIPS TOWARD THE BALL, ADDRESS TO IMPACT

text.tspan: AIcoach checks every swing against the same rule table.
Each row gets a measurement, the threshold it was held to,
a confidence band and the key frames it rests on. Then the
card is marked the way a scorer would mark it.
A coach who is not sure says so. AIcoach would rather
leave a cell empty than fill it with a guess. These are
the four places that honesty shows up on the card.
Your clip is filmed face-on, at
30 fps, with your feet cut off.
Reasons: face-on view detected · feet out of
frame · 30 fps. Each one links to a filming guide step.
Your swing has none of the
three faults in the rule table.
“Unverified — confirm with a coach”, confidence: low.
Analysed with a visible warning. Over the top is
always capped at medium (hand path, no club tracking).
Restricted hip rotation is labelled likely, and names
the measured mechanism that points to it.
Fits inside a practice session: one swing, filmed from
behind, answered before your next bucket. Works from the

the table is labelled “Unverified — confirm with a coach”
Hips move toward the ball, address to impact
Posture angle change in the downswing vs
Hand path in transition above the backswing
